title: Realizable (reg, deg h)-Pairs for Cover Ideals via Independence Polynomials
summary: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices and set $R=\Bbbk[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, with edge ideal $I(G)$ and cover ideal $J(G)$. We give an explicit description of the $h$-polynomial of $R/J(G)$, in a form that extends to the Alexander dual of any squarefree monomial ideal. We then express $\textrm{deg } h_{R/I(G)}(t)$ and $\textrm{deg } h_{R/J(G)}(t)$ in terms of the independence polynomial $P_G(x)=\sum_{i\ge 0} g_i x^i$ via an invariant $M(G)$, the multiplicity of $x=-1$ as a root of $P_G(x)$.
